details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue and segment performance (S1–S5) lead directly to profitability metrics (S6–S10), which in turn explain cash-flow and balance-sheet changes (S11–S14). Capital expenditures, store count, and employment figures (S15–S16) are presented as factual outcomes of the period’s operations. Return ratios (S17) follow naturally from the profit and asset figures already stated. The final governance and strategic remarks (S18–S19) close the narrative without introducing contradictions or circular reasoning. No sentence negates or undermines another, and the overall structure follows a clear chronological and thematic progression from top-line results through profitability, cash generation, financial position, and forward-looking commentary.
